weaknesses: Abstract claims theoretical generality unmatched in robustness literature without sufficient comparative analysis.
Experimental results imply representativeness but lack a broader range of architectures and perturbation types.
The novelty of the proposed method is overstated as it builds on existing randomized smoothing techniques without clear differentiation.
strengths: Introduces a novel incremental approach to randomized smoothing that significantly reduces certification time.
Demonstrates empirical speedups of up to 4.1x over traditional methods, showcasing practical applicability.
Provides a clear framework for reusing certification guarantees, which could facilitate future research in adversarial robustness.
